incident_text: A hiker fell and cannot bear weight on an ankle on a remote rocky trail.
We are lost in heavy rain and visibility is poor; phone battery is low.
Fresh landslide debris blocks the path after heavy rainfall.
Fast water has flooded the trail crossing.
A hiker is dizzy and exhausted in hot weather with little water.
A wild animal is near the path; the hikers have kept their distance.
Thunderstorm approaching an exposed ridge with strong winds.
A damaged bridge blocks the known trail and crossing is unsafe.
